scripts.dev:desktop: IS_DESKTOP_BUILD=true vite build && cp lib/neutralino.js dist/ && mv dist/desktop.html dist/index.html && npx neu run

scripts.build:desktop: npx neu update && IS_DESKTOP_BUILD=true vite build && cp lib/neutralino.js dist/ && mv dist/desktop.html dist/index.html && npx neu build && mv dist/forge desktop/

scripts.build:ios: IS_MOBILE_BUILD=true vite build && mv dist/mobile.html dist/index.html && npx cap copy ios

scripts.setup: npx cap add android && npx neu update
